Heavy U.S. interceptor use in the Iran conflict has depleted stockpiles by 65%, prompting the transfer of missile defense assets away from South Korea.

Sacrificing foundational deterrence in Northeast Asia to sustain an expanding Middle East conflict creates cascading vulnerabilities across global alliances.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing short-term tactical redistribution (WHERE) with long-term strategic stability (WHY). It's a classic bait-and-switch of alliance security.

Social Physics Analysis:
Hoarding finite military assets under defensive pretexts while projecting readiness masks the severe erosion of deterrence and alliance trust.

The Trajectory: The Path of Destruction.
When you map resource depletion to strategic vulnerability, it plots a direct trajectory toward Destruction. Negative feedback loops collapse stability.

The Unavoidable Truth: Finite missile stocks cannot sustain simultaneous multi-theater wars.

The Unavoidable Lie: Strategic withdrawals do not weaken regional deterrence.

Alethekanon:
Military overextension without industrial capacity scaling is strategic suicide. Numbers matter more than rhetoric when deterrence is tested. 🌐

Allies relying on security guarantees are left terrified as their shields are quietly unbolted and shipped away. It breaks trust when it's needed most.
